Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.liquidity

Record Class KfePpmAdjustRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.liquidity.KfePpmAdjustRequest
Record Components:
channelPoint - outpoint identifying the channel whose policy is adjusted
currentPpm - current forwarding fee in parts per million, when known
acceleratedDrain - whether the policy should prioritize draining local liquidity
baseFeeMsat - optional fixed forwarding fee in millisatoshis
public record KfePpmAdjustRequest(String channelPoint, Long currentPpm, Boolean acceleratedDrain, Long baseFeeMsat) extends Record
Input used to calculate or apply a channel forwarding-fee adjustment.
